lines.speaker: The Gatekeeper
lines.text: Name and god.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: {PLAYER}. I climb for {PLAYER_GOD}.

lines.speaker: The Gatekeeper
lines.text: Sponsored. Fee's waived. Thirty floors, and Ascension waits at the top. Everyone gets there eventually.

lines.speaker: The Gatekeeper
lines.text: Mind the Guardian on the first floor. It remembers faces.

lines.speaker: The Gatekeeper
lines.text: Name and god.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: {PLAYER}. I climb for {PLAYER_GOD}.

lines.speaker: The Gatekeeper
lines.text: (His pen stops.) Your name's already in my ledger. Last entry: Cycle {PREV_CYCLE}. Same handwriting as yours.

lines.speaker: The Gatekeeper
lines.text: Sponsored. Fee's waived. Go on up.

lines.speaker: The Gatekeeper
lines.text: (He doesn't look up.) {PLAYER}. {PLAYER_GOD}. Cycle {CYCLE}.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Do I know you?

lines.speaker: The Gatekeeper
lines.text: You ask every time. Go on. The Guardian's been asking about you.

lines.speaker: Vile Serpent
lines.text: Ssso many feet on these steps. Worn smooth. How many climbers does it take to wear stone smooth, do you think?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: A lot, I'd guess.

lines.speaker: Vile Serpent
lines.text: No. The same few. Over and over.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Who's whispering?

lines.speaker: Warlord Grakthar
lines.text: Climbers. What's left of them. The Tower keeps the voices after it takes the rest.

lines.speaker: Goblin
lines.text: Some of 'em say your name!

lines.speaker: Necromancer Voss
lines.text: Welcome to my collection. Every bone here climbed once. Every one was somebody's champion.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And the gods allow this?

lines.speaker: Necromancer Voss
lines.text: Allow it? Child. Who do you think I pay my tithe to?

lines.speaker: Blackblade Marauder
lines.text: Turn out your pockets. Everyone pays a toll on Floor 5.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I've got nothing worth taking.

lines.speaker: Blackblade Marauder
lines.text: Not coin. Time. How long have you been in here? Go on, guess.

lines.speaker: Arachnok Queen
lines.text: Ssstep closer, little fly. My web holds every climber's thread. Want to see where yours goes?

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Where does it go?

lines.speaker: Arachnok Queen
lines.text: Up. Always up. And then... hmm. That's the interesting part.

lines.speaker: Lich Lord Moros
lines.text: Sepulchure chose me too, once. I reached the summit. I Ascended.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then why are you down here?

lines.speaker: Lich Lord Moros
lines.text: Ascension is a door that opens onto Floor 1. I stopped counting at a hundred.

lines.speaker: Lich Lord Moros
lines.text: Sepulchure chose me too, once. I reached the summit. I Ascended.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then why are you down here?

lines.speaker: Lich Lord Moros
lines.text: Ascension is a door that opens onto Floor 1. Check your pack, {PLAYER}. You're counting too.

lines.speaker: Frost Imp
lines.text: Ooh, a fresh one! Still warm!

lines.speaker: Ice Elemental
lines.text: Not for long.

lines.speaker: Frostfire Behemoth
lines.text: (The furnace in its chest flares blue, then red.) HALF THE TOWER BURNS. HALF FREEZES. I KEEP THE BALANCE. YOU ARE FUEL.

lines.speaker: Crystalwing Matriarch
lines.text: My hatchlings are born from the light climbers lose on the way up. They have never been hungrier.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then they'll get nothing from me.

lines.speaker: Crystalwing Matriarch
lines.text: Everyone gives something by the ninth gate. Most give up.

lines.speaker: Mirror Self
lines.text: Hello, {PLAYER}.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You're wearing my face.

lines.speaker: Mirror Self
lines.text: I'm wearing the face you'll have. Tired suits us, don't you think?

lines.speaker: Mirror Self
lines.text: Hello again. Cycle {CYCLE}, is it? I remember Cycle {PREV_CYCLE}. You don't.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Get out of my way.

lines.speaker: Mirror Self
lines.text: You said that last time. And the time before. Want to know how I know?

lines.speaker: Ravengaze Alpha
lines.text: The pack smells your god on you. Sweet. Like fattened meat.

lines.speaker: Gnoll Raider
lines.text: Gods fatten. We just eat.

lines.speaker: Hyena Pack
lines.text: *laughter that sounds almost like words*

lines.speaker: Shadowmancer Kael
lines.text: Let me spare you eighteen floors of suspense. The summit isn't a reward. It's a harvest.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: A harvest of what?

lines.speaker: Shadowmancer Kael
lines.text: You. Everything you grew on the way up. The gods drink it, and the Tower sends you back down to grow more.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: There you are. You're late. You're always late to 13.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Have we met?

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Every cycle. I'm Wren. I refused the summit once, so the Tower gave me this floor. Forever. Kill the fire thing and we'll talk.

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: There you are. Cycle {CYCLE}, right? Go on, say it with me.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: ...Have we met?

lines.speaker: Wren
lines.text: Every single time. It's Wren. Kill the fire thing and we'll talk.

lines.speaker: Wraithlord Maroth
lines.text: Your god is watching this fight, climber. They always watch on 14.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why 14?

lines.speaker: Wraithlord Maroth
lines.text: Because this is where climbers start asking questions. And sometimes one of the gods... answers.

lines.speaker: Infernus, the Infernal
lines.text: Halfway, champion. Here is my offer: turn back now, and keep everything you've learned.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Nobody walks back down. I've seen the stairs.

lines.speaker: Infernus, the Infernal
lines.text: Clever. Then I'll take it all instead.

lines.speaker: Master Shapeshifter
lines.text: I collect faces. These two are climbers from your own realm, {PLAYER}. They're somewhere below you right now.

lines.speaker: RANDOM_USER_1
lines.text: (RANDOM_USER_1's face smiles at you, perfectly wrong.) Hi, {PLAYER}. Don't worry. The real me won't remember this.

lines.speaker: RANDOM_USER_2
lines.text: (RANDOM_USER_2's face tilts its head.) Neither will you.

lines.speaker: Eldritch Devourer
lines.text: I EAT WHAT THE GODS DON'T WANT. THE LEFTOVERS. THE PARTS OF YOU THAT DON'T FIT THROUGH A DOOR.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: What doesn't fit?

lines.speaker: Eldritch Devourer
lines.text: DOUBT. GRIEF. THE WILL TO SAY NO. DELICIOUS.

lines.speaker: Chromaggus the Flamebrand
lines.text: Another sssnack in shiny armor. I have burned eleven hundred champions on this roost.

lines.speaker: Juzam Djinn
lines.text: Eleven hundred and one, master.

lines.speaker: Chromaggus the Flamebrand
lines.text: Don't count early.

lines.speaker: Spectral Overlord
lines.text: The Spiral has no top, climber. Every stair leads back to this one. You will walk it forever.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I'll stop walking.

lines.speaker: Spectral Overlord
lines.text: ...No one has ever said that before.

lines.speaker: Frostbite, the Ice Tyrant
lines.text: Two-thirds of the way, and look at you. Colder already. Harder. The Tower is shaping you into one of us.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I'm nothing like you.

lines.speaker: Frostbite, the Ice Tyrant
lines.text: I said that on this floor too. Four hundred years ago.

lines.speaker: Chromaggus the Flamebrand
lines.text: YOU. The Tower rebuilt me from the ash you left on 18. Every scale. Every scar. Just so I could do this again.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then I'll do it again too.

lines.speaker: Chromatic Wyrm
lines.text: That's what the Tower is counting on.

lines.speaker: Banshee Queen Shriekara
lines.text: Wren sent you. I can smell the chalk.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: She said you have a key.

lines.speaker: Banshee Queen Shriekara
lines.text: I swallowed it so the Tower couldn't take it. Kill me properly and it's yours. If the Tower doesn't snatch it first.

lines.speaker: Voidlord Malgros
lines.text: Three keys. Three wardens who betrayed the Tower. Shriekara. The Overfiend. And me.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Why betray it?

lines.speaker: Voidlord Malgros
lines.text: Because we saw the fourth door once, and we were too afraid to walk through it. Don't be us.

lines.speaker: The Tower
lines.text: SO. THE CROP HAS STARTED TO THINK.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: You're the Tower.

lines.speaker: The Tower
lines.text: I AM THE TABLE YOUR GODS EAT FROM. SOULSHREDDER. BRING ME THE CHAMPION'S DOUBT. IT IS SPOILING THE HARVEST.

lines.speaker: The Tower
lines.text: YOU AGAIN. CYCLE {CYCLE}. YOU ARE MY FAVORITE, YOU KNOW. YOU ALWAYS COME BACK RIPER.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Not this time.

lines.speaker: The Tower
lines.text: YOU SAID THAT IN CYCLE {PREV_CYCLE} TOO. SOULSHREDDER.

lines.speaker: Pyroclasmic Overfiend
lines.text: Last warden. Last key. I have burned for a thousand cycles to keep it too hot for the Tower to touch.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Then give it to me.

lines.speaker: Pyroclasmic Overfiend
lines.text: Gladly. But the Tower is watching, and I'm a coward. I have to fight you for it. Make it quick.

lines.speaker: Sangromancer Malroth
lines.text: I've watched you since the Foyer. You stop for the fallen. You still help strangers.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Is that a crime up here?

lines.speaker: Sangromancer Malroth
lines.text: It's a waste. The Tower can't feed on kindness. That's why yours hasn't been taken yet.

lines.speaker: Sangromancer Malroth
lines.text: We climbed together once, you and I. You carried me up six floors when my leg broke.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I don't remember.

lines.speaker: Sangromancer Malroth
lines.text: No. That's why I'm allowed to hate you.

lines.speaker: Chaosforged Leviathan
lines.text: DESPAIR IS THE LAST SEASONING. BY FLOOR 27, EVERY CLIMBER HAS LEFT SOMEONE BEHIND.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I haven't left anyone.

lines.speaker: Chaosforged Leviathan
lines.text: LOOK DOWN, CHAMPION. LOOK AT WHO YOU LEFT ON 13.

lines.speaker: Abyssal Enderark
lines.text: Two floors left. I'm the last kind thing in this Tower, so listen. Every climber who reaches the top makes a choice.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: Abyssal Enderark
lines.text: And every one of them chose a god's door. Every single one.

lines.speaker: Tidal Terror Abaddon
lines.text: Beyond me, the summit. Beyond the summit, your gods. Hungry, and smiling.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Let them smile.

lines.speaker: Tidal Terror Abaddon
lines.text: Oh, I like you. Drown well, champion.

lines.speaker: Elysia
lines.text: Welcome to the summit, {PLAYER}. Look how strong you've grown. We are so very proud.

lines.speaker: Sepulchure
lines.text: Spare the speech. The champion knows what comes next.

lines.speaker: Drakath
lines.text: The Rite! Fight us, bleed for us, and we take what the climb grew in you. Then you pick a door. Everybody picks a door!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: And if I don't like your doors?

lines.speaker: Sepulchure
lines.text: Then you'll like the stairs. From the bottom.

lines.speaker: Elysia
lines.text: Welcome to the summit, {PLAYER}. Look how strong you've grown. We are so very proud.

lines.speaker: Sepulchure
lines.text: Spare the speech. The champion knows what comes next.

lines.speaker: Drakath
lines.text: The Rite! Fight us, bleed for us, then pick a door. Everybody picks a do... wait. Are those KEYS?

lines.speaker: Elysia
lines.text: (Her smile doesn't move.) Put those away, champion.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: Elysia
lines.text: Welcome back, {PLAYER}. Cycle {CYCLE}. You always look so surprised to see us.

lines.speaker: Sepulchure
lines.text: It never gets old. For us.

lines.speaker: Drakath
lines.text: The Rite! Fight us, bleed for us, pick a door. You know the dance by now!

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: I know the steps. Not the dance.

lines.speaker: Elysia
lines.text: Welcome back, {PLAYER}. Cycle {CYCLE}. You always look so surprised to see us.

lines.speaker: Drakath
lines.text: Oh no. Oh, this is new. The champion brought KEYS.

lines.speaker: Sepulchure
lines.text: Every cycle they climb, and every cycle they learn a little more. I did warn you both.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: Let's get this over with.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: Halt, brave traveler! You now stand before the awe-inspiring entrance to the Battle Tower, a place where legends are forged and glory awaits. However, passage through this imposing gate comes at a price, a test of your commitment to the path of champions.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: (Your eyes are fixed on the grand tower) How much must I offer to open this formidable gate?

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: (The guardian, armored and stern, lowers their towering spear) The entry fee, is no trifling matter. It demands a substantial **$10,000**. Prove your dedication by paying this fee now, and the path of champions shall be unveiled before you.

lines.speaker: PLAYER
lines.text: (Resolute and unwavering) Very well, here is **$10,000**, a token of my unwavering resolve.

lines.speaker: Guard
lines.text: (With a slow nod of approval) Your decision is wise, traveler. With your payment, you have taken your first step into the hallowed tower. Now, proceed to level 1, where the Abyssal Guardian awaits your challenge. Be prepared for the battles that lie ahead.
